record.label: Interference and phase correction in the coefficient lookup
record.statement: The lookup uses Hadamards and $T$ and $T^\dagger$ gates to compute the coefficient bits by interference. The $Z$ and $CZ$ corrections cancel the input-dependent signs within each lookup pass.
record.boundary: The first Hadamard puts the coefficient qubit in a superposition. The $T$ and $T^\dagger$ gates encode bit products in the relative phase, and the second Hadamard recombines the two terms to compute the coefficient bit. The basis-state calculation also gives the phase of the output, since an input-dependent phase can change a superposition even when the basis-state labels are correct.
